title: Masked Differential-linear Distinguishers and Quantum Approaches
summary: We introduce masked auto-correlation, a new primitive for the cryptanalysis of symmetric-key primitives, together with a quantum attack pipeline built on it. For a permutation $f$, output masks $α,β$, and an input difference $w$, masked auto-correlation (MAC) measures the correlation between the masked outputs $α\cdot f(x)$ and $β\cdot f(x\oplus w)$.
